meta.title: Product skills
meta.description: Five product-management skills in one plugin. product-mindset (产品心法 v2.0.0): a methodology and document router covering product briefs, project diagnosis, PRDs, competitor research, prioritisation, review meetings and launch reviews. quick-prototype (快速原型 v4.3.0): single-file interactive HTML prototypes for six device forms, plus printable HTML reports. product-prototype-review: six-dimension review of a prototype and its business description, reported with P0/P1/P2 priorities. requirement-analysis: decomposes requirements into the five-level system–module–feature-group–operation–rule structure and writes a traceable Excel workbook. axure-prd-docx: renders an Axure prototype, a five-level requirement table and a document template into a DOCX requirements document with screenshots and rule tables. Usage: ask in plain language, such as "write a PRD", "review this prototype", "break these requirements into a table" or "turn the prototype into a requirements document"; the agent matches a skill by its description, so no /skill-name is needed. Skill bodies, references and templates are read from this plugin on demand, and unloaded files never enter the conversation. axure-prd-docx bundles its Node dependencies (vendor/modules, about 3.7 MB; no npm install), and requirement-analysis uses the Python runtime DSH ships with (openpyxl included). Turning the plugin off removes all five skills from every session immediately; the plugin makes no network requests, writes no files and registers no model tools.
